dedupe_keys.name: ni water annual information return air tables on opendatani

description: NI Water produced the Annual Information Return tables that it submits to the Northern Ireland utility regulator, published on OpenDataNI as 59 datasets: key outputs such as customer service, non-financial measures such as the security of supply index for the critical period, capital investment monitoring, fixed asset additions and asset maintenance by asset type, additional operating costs from capital schemes, and public expenditure reconciliation. Coverage is Northern Ireland's public water and sewerage utility. The tables are a free download as ODS files under the UK Open Government Licence, and they are also listed on data.europa.eu. Caveats: each table is a separate file for one return year, the newest seen is 2020-21, and they are the utility's own regulatory figures. Simulation uses: security of supply, investment and asset maintenance figures for utility capacity and resilience planning. Related records: Statistics Norway's water supply and wastewater statistics (data-ssb-norway-municipal-water-supply-wastewater-statistics).
